limitations: This packet supplies row 276 only: perfectness of the cosection-reduced self-Ext cone on the retained finite rows.
It proves perfectness by importing the universal perfect complexes, applying proper perfect pushforward to RHom(F,F), and using closure of perfect complexes under fibres.

It does not prove cosection surjectivity, define determinant lines, construct square-root orientations, construct quotient orientation, prove transition compatibility, construct BBDJS vanishing cycles, or define protected integration.
